scenario.description: Xsi had the order to spy the humans for the Necromancer. But she wasn´t lucky. The humans realised her plans, hunted and prisonded her in a small valley. Now it`s on you to bring Xsi back home to the Necromancer. All maps are planed to play "expert". If you want choose your difficulty!
scenario.name: Evil Way Home
scenario.scenarioDescription: You have to fight all enemies. Heroes experience is not limited. I hope you have done the Obelisk Quiz right. Don`t loose Xsi

skills.description:
{Expert Wisdom}

Expert Wisdom allows your hero to learn fifth level spells.
skills.name: Wisdom

skills.description:
{Expert Necromancy}

Raises up to 30% of defeated living creatures as Skeleton Knights, limited by their health. With the Cloak of the Undead King: Lich Kings.
skills.name: Necromancy

skills.description:
{Expert Learning}

Expert Learning increases a hero's earned experience by 15%.
skills.name: Learning

skills.description:
{Expert Armorer}

Expert Armorer reduces all damage inflicted against the hero's troops by 15%.
skills.name: Armorer

skills.description:
{Expert Fire Magic}

Expert Fire Magic allows your hero to cast Fire spells at reduced cost and maximum effectiveness.
skills.name: Fire Magic

skills.description:
{Expert Artillery}

Expert Artillery gives control of the ballista to the hero, allowing two shots which inflict double damage.
skills.name: Artillery

skills.description:
{Expert Mysticism}

Expert Mysticism allows your hero to regenerate 4 spell points per day.
skills.name: Mysticism

skills.description:
{Expert Eagle Eye}

Expert Eagle Eye gives your hero a 60% chance to learn any spell up to 4th level used in combat.
skills.name: Eagle Eye

skills.description:
{Expert Pathfinding}

Expert Pathfinding reduces the movement penalty for rough terrain by 75%.
skills.name: Pathfinding

skills.description:
{Expert Archery}

Expert Archery increases the damage done by range attacking creatures by 50%.
skills.name: Archery

skills.description:
{Expert Logistics}

Expert Logistics increases your hero's movement points over land by 30%.
skills.name: Logistics

skills.description:
{Expert Scouting}

Expert Scouting allows your hero to see 3 squares further into the shroud.
skills.name: Scouting

skills.description:
{Expert Diplomacy}

Expert Diplomacy allows you to negotiate with monsters who are weaker than your group, and reduces the cost of surrendering by 60%.
skills.name: Diplomacy

skills.description:
{Expert Navigation}

Expert Navigation increases your hero's movement points at sea by 150%.
skills.name: Navigation

skills.description:
{Expert Leadership}

Expert Leadership increases your hero's troops' morale by 3.
skills.name: Leadership

skills.description:
{Expert Luck}

Expert Luck increases your hero's luck by 3.
skills.name: Luck

skills.description:
{Expert Ballistics}

Expert Ballistics gives control of the catapult to the hero, allowing two aimed shots at maximum damage.
skills.name: Ballistics

skills.description:
{Expert Estates}

With Estates, a hero contributes 500 gold per day to your cause.
skills.name: Estates

skills.description:
{Expert Air Magic}

Expert Air Magic allows your hero to cast Air spells at reduced cost and maximum effectiveness.
skills.name: Air Magic

skills.description:
{Expert Water Magic}

Expert Water Magic allows your hero to cast Water spells at reduced cost and maximum effectiveness.
skills.name: Water Magic

skills.description:
{Expert Earth Magic}

Expert Earth Magic allows your hero to cast Earth spells at reduced cost and maximum effectiveness.
skills.name: Earth Magic

skills.description:
{Expert Scholar}

Expert Scholar allows heroes to teach each other any spell up to 4th level, effectively trading spells between spell books.
skills.name: Scholar

skills.description:
{Expert Tactics}

Expert Tactics allows you to rearrange your troops just before combat, within seven hex rows of the commanding hero.
skills.name: Tactics

skills.description:
{Expert Offense}

Expert Offense increases all hand-to-hand damage inflicted by the hero's troops by 30%.
skills.name: Offense

skills.description:
{Expert Intelligence}

Expert Intelligence doubles a hero's normal maximum spell points.
skills.name: Intelligence

skills.description:
{Expert Sorcery}

Expert Sorcery causes a hero's spells to inflict an additional 15% damage in combat.
skills.name: Sorcery

skills.description:
{Expert Resistance}

Expert Resistance endows a hero's troops with 20% magic resistance.
skills.name: Resistance

skills.description:
{Expert First Aid}

Expert First Aid gives control of the first aid tent to the hero, healing 100 points of damage to the first unit of the selected stack.
skills.name: First Aid

skills.scope: All28 Expert skills granted by unchanged final zc4 initializer; native storage and mobile visibility/scroll stability. No level-up cap change.
